in_marathi.name: Diyakar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's light bearer
in_marathi.long_meaning: Diyakar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Diyakar is the name given to those who carry the divine light of knowledge and wisdom. This name signifies enlightenment and illumination, symbolizing the inner light that guides one through life.

vedic_reference.note: This name is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘दिया’ (Diya) meaning 'lamp' and ‘कर’ (kar) meaning 'to do'. It can be translated to English as 'one who does the work of lamps' or 'giver of lamps'. This name can also be interpreted as 'one who performs charitable deeds' or 'giver of charity'.
